intro.text: The young heir of a minor noble house in Luthadel.

items.text: Escorted Valette Renoux to a ball at Keep Hasting after his original partner fell ill, and discussed with Kliss the deaths of Charrs Entrone and Ardous and Callins Geffenry. He was polite, but Vin had to hide her disdain for the noble attitudes he shared.
Played shelldry with Lords Rene and Tyden; having missed their last game, he had an obligator witness his promise to come to the next. He hurried off when Shan Elariel came over to speak to Valette.
